_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "companies" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "tax_id" TEXT NULL, "logo_path" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "clients" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "projects" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'prospect', "project_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sites" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES projects (id), "latitude" REAL NOT NULL, "longitude" REAL NOT NULL, "altitude_m" REAL NULL, "time_zone" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_text" TEXT NULL, "accuracy_m" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "utility_bills" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "period_start" TEXT NOT NULL, "period_end" TEXT NOT NULL, "billing_period" TEXT NOT NULL, "energy_kwh" REAL NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MXN', "tariff_code" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "photos" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "stage" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "width_px" INTEGER NOT NULL, "height_px" INTEGER NOT NULL, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "taken_at" TEXT NULL, "caption" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "documents" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "roof_images" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES projects (id), "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_path" TEXT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NULL, "width_px" INTEGER NULL, "height_px" INTEGER NULL, "meters_per_pixel" REAL NULL, "calibration_line" TEXT NULL, "verification_line" TEXT NULL, "north_angle_deg" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "north_source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'imageUp', "magnetic_declination_deg" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "roof_planes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "polygon" TEXT NOT NULL, "tilt_deg" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "tilt_source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "azimuth_deg" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 180.0, "azimuth_edge_index" INTEGER NULL, "edge_setback_m" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "walkways" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "obstacles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "outline" TEXT NOT NULL, "center_x" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "center_y" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "width_m" REAL NOT NULL, "depth_m" REAL NULL, "rotation_deg" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "points" TEXT NULL, "height_m" REAL NOT NULL, "height_source" TEXT NOT NULL, "tank_liters" INTEGER NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "horizon_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "points" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "panel_models" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "manufacturer" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "pmax_w" REAL NOT NULL, "voc_v" REAL NOT NULL, "isc_a" REAL NOT NULL, "vmp_v" REAL NOT NULL, "imp_a" REAL NOT NULL, "gamma_pmax_pct" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT -0.35, "beta_voc_pct" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT -0.28, "beta_vmp_pct" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT -0.37, "length_m" REAL NOT NULL, "width_m" REAL NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "cell_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'mono', "cell_count" INTEGER NULL, "bifacial" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("bifacial" IN (0, 1)), "bifaciality_pct" REAL NULL, "max_series_fuse_a" REAL NULL, "max_system_voltage_v" REAL NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inverter_models" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "manufacturer" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'string', "pac_w" REAL NOT NULL, "vdc_max_v" REAL NOT NULL, "mppt_min_v" REAL NOT NULL, "mppt_max_v" REAL NOT NULL, "mppt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "imax_per_mppt_a" REAL NOT NULL, "isc_max_per_mppt_a" REAL NULL, "efficiency_pct" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 96.0, "phases" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "ac_voltage_v" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 220.0, "iac_max_a" REAL NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "optimizer_models" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "manufacturer" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "pmax_in_w" REAL NOT NULL, "vin_max_v" REAL NOT NULL, "imax_in_a" REAL NOT NULL, "vout_max_v" REAL NULL, "iout_max_a" REAL NULL, "efficiency_pct" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 99.0, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "battery_models" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "manufacturer" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "chemistry" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'lfp', "capacity_kwh" REAL NOT NULL, "usable_kwh" REAL NULL, "nominal_voltage_v" REAL NOT NULL, "max_charge_kw" REAL NULL, "max_discharge_kw" REAL NULL, "cycles" INTEGER NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pv_designs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES projects (id), "panel_model_id" TEXT NULL, "inverter_model_id" TEXT NULL, "inverter_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "optimizer_model_id" TEXT NULL, "battery_model_id" TEXT NULL, "system_voltage_limit_v" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 600.0, "losses" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "shade_threshold_pct" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 10.0, "grid_voltage_v" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 220.0, "wind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "array_layouts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "roof_plane_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES roof_planes (id), "panel_model_id" TEXT NULL, "orientation" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'portrait', "mount" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'flush', "rack_tilt_deg" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 15.0, "rack_azimuth_deg" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 180.0, "gap_m" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.02, "row_gap_m" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.02, "clearance_m" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.3, "row_spacing_m" REAL NULL, "panels" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "string_configs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "inverter_index" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "mppt_index" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "series" INTEGER NOT NULL, "parallel" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "edited" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("edited" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "electrical_runs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "length_m" REAL NOT NULL, "material" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'copper', "raceway" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'rooftop13to90mm', "ambient_c" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 40.0, "conductors" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2, "chosen_size" TEXT NULL, "result_size" TEXT NULL, "drop_percent" REAL NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "protection_devices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "rating_a" REAL NULL, "voltage_v" REAL NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "conductor_size" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "simulation_results" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "pdc_w" REAL NOT NULL, "pac_w" REAL NOT NULL, "first_year_kwh" REAL NOT NULL, "lifetime_kwh" REAL NOT NULL, "years" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 25, "monthly_kwh" TEXT NOT NULL, "yearly_kwh" TEXT NOT NULL, "clipped_kwh" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "shading_loss_pct" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "specific_yield" REAL NOT NULL, "performance_ratio" REAL NOT NULL, "losses" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "weather_label" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
